name: Notre-Dame Cathedral
nameVi: Vương cung Thánh đường Đức Bà
kicker: Twin towers at the head of Đồng Khởi
summary: Twin-spired cathedral at the head of Đồng Khởi: look from the square in the early morning for both towers. The church is at 1 Công trường Công xã Paris, opposite the post office, in unplastered brick from Marseille, consecrated in 1880. The statue in front is described as Carrara marble from Pietrasanta, and also as alabaster.
timeNeeded: A look from the square. Check on arrival.

notice.title: The interior hour was not confirmed
notice.body: Vietnam Tourism prints an interior clock of 7:30 a.m.–12 p.m. and 1:30–5 p.m., inside a block it also uses for other sights. That split clock is not chosen. Check on arrival. Ask at the gate.

body: The church is at 1 Công trường Công xã Paris, Phường Sài Gòn, at the head of Đồng Khởi. The national account uses Ben Nghe, District 1. Both names stay. The English name on that page is the Cathedral Basilica of Our Lady of the Immaculate Conception. Design is credited to architect Bourard and Bishop Colombert, consecrated in 1880, in unplastered brick ordered from Marseille. The national page dates construction from 1863 to 1880 and says the materials were imported from France.

The statue in front has two descriptions. One calls Đức Mẹ Hòa Bình Carrara marble carved at Pietrasanta. The other calls an alabaster statue of the Virgin in the square a figure said to have wept once in 2005. Both stay. Come early for the look from the square. The post office is the building opposite. The photograph is the facade: both towers, the clock, and the rose window, with scaffolding along the right side. The spire tips sit above the frame. Ask at the gate about the interior.

figures.caption: Inside, a votive chapel. This is not the facade on the square.
